verdict.rationale: Ollama is a local LLM inference runtime, so using x86 instruction sets like AVX, AVX2, AVX512, and AMX to speed up CPU inference is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never mentions any of these instruction sets or CPU-specific optimizations. The only CPU reference is a community report of falling back to CPU when no ROCm library was found, which says nothing about instruction-set use.
